site.tagline: Tell it what to do. Your files stay on your device.
site.supportingMessage: Local-first document automation for PDF and Word files.
site.secondaryMessage: Process, organize, merge, convert and manage documents locally in your browser.
site.description: LocalDocu is a privacy-first, local-first document tool. Merge, split, compress, rotate, and convert PDF and Word files in your browser — document contents stay on your device.
site.shortDescription: Privacy-first local PDF and Word automation. Files stay on your device.

trust.offlineBannerBody: Local document tools continue to work on this page. Avoid refreshing — it can clear documents in this session. Prefer a normal reload over hard refresh (Shift+Reload): hard refresh bypasses the service worker and usually fails while offline.
trust.detailsOnlineBody: Network available. Local document processing still happens on this device.
trust.detailsOfflineBody: Offline. Local document tools continue to work. Going offline does not stop an in-progress local operation — refreshing or closing the tab can. Soft reload uses the cached app shell; hard refresh usually cannot while offline.
trust.contentsProcessedLocally: Document contents are processed on this device.
trust.localDocuAiOffDetail: LocalDocu AI: Off (desktop, metadata-only intent — not in this web release)
trust.notUploadedFootnote: Files are not uploaded for document processing. Processed locally on your device.
